paragraphs.text: The Hobbit features a series of 40 promo box toppers referred to as "Middle-earth classic artist" cards.

Each of these cards was originally part of The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth or Lord of the Rings Commander and features new borderless artwork by a well-known fantasy artist. Each Play Booster box and Collector Booster box includes a Box Topper that contains 1 traditional foil Middle-earth classic artist card. Non-foil (HOC #13-52) and surge foil (HOC #53-92) Middle-earth classic artist cards appear in Collector Boosters.
